content: Ngwiiyà a Yɛsu
Atɔŋ, mɛ alàyɔɔb Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ kàlakyään mɛ, alà làwɛl bɛ, alà làpɛ bɛ mɔ̈ɔ̈ amu la,
anà u mbwo a la bɛ làsàwà mɔ̈ɔ̈ isàkal naa bɛ lan'kaar la asànaa kàlakyään mɛ, kya naa tɛy, bɛ làlàsà làkwikilà a bunàbun.
Mɛ kàtàlalɔŋ indiir atàtwɛb kàwɛl mɛ ŋakwo naa: Klistɔ kàkü ntɔn man'be abi, asànaa itɛɛnà Ndaa Aŋàsɔn.
Nde bàkyer un'dyee, waa kàwiyà kà ilä kyàtär.
Nde kàyàmɛnà akà Petɔlà, ungö akà Bàkwem Aŋiyweel.
Ungö apan, nde kàyamɛnà umbàla mwɛy akà atɔŋ aŋàsöön nkam tyeen. Bàmbɔɔn uboo a ba bye anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ tii papanà, bamwɛy bàkyàkwà.
Ungö nde kàkàmɛnà akà Zyak, anà akà antööm banswà.
Ungöngö a ba banswà, nde kàyàmɛnà akà mɛ sye, mɛ mwan mpa kàkölà nsöŋ.
Ntɔn mɛ in'wà wà ikikye uboo a an'tööm, mɛ in'kwe anki ban'bel ntööm, ntɔn mɛ kàmɛɛy Ikööŋ a Nzam nkwaaŋ.

Wɛɛ in'wà mɛ abà, mɛ in'wà ntɔn kab a ngway a Nzam, anà kab a ngway ande alà akà mɛ làkäl anki làbunàbun. Wɛɛ mɛ kàsäl aŋasöön ba banswà: kà mɛ anki, wɛɛ kab a ngway a Nzam alà amu mɛ.
Kyakin, itàkal mɛ, itàkal ba, undiir ikyäänà bi awà, undiir làsi bɛ làkwikilà.
Isàkal ban'kyään naa Klistɔ kàwiyà uboo a akü, ntɔn nkye bamwɛy uboo a bɛ ban'kwo ba mutɛn naa ngwiiyà a akü yatɛy?
Isàkal naa ngwiiyà a akü yatɛy, abwɛy Klistɔ kàwiyà anki,
isàkal naa Klistɔ kàwiyà anki, an'lɔɔŋ abi mà màbunàbun, làkwikilà abɛ sye là làbunàbun.
Apan, imɛnà naa bi ibà ambäl a Nzam bàloor, ntɔn bi kàtwääl imbäl asin mutɛn naa Nzam kàwiiy Klistɔ, wɛɛ nde kun'wiiy anki, kya isàkal naa ndandaa akü bàfàwiyà anki.
Isàkal naa akü bàfàwiyà anki, Klistɔ sye kàwiyà anki.
Ntɔn, isàkal naa Klistɔ kàwiyà anki, làkwikilà abɛ là làbunàbun, tii lalà bɛ làbà uboo a man'be.
Abun sye, baar bàkü amu Klistɔ bàkyàkyàbwà.
Isàkal naa bi kàsi làkyän abi amu Klistɔ ntɔn mɔ̈ɔ̈ awà mpɛl, bi ibà baar a ngweel a ngyɛb aŋàsöön baar banswà.
Wɛɛ yà ndandaa naa Klistɔ kàwiyà uboo a akü anà wà mbɛŋ atàtwɛb uboo a baar bàkü.
Ntɔn, u mbwo a mbuur mwɛy ukwà waa bayi, abun u mbwo a mbuur mwɛy sye ngwiiyà a akü waa yàyi.
Ifà imwɛy baar banswà bàfàkwà amu Adam, amu Klistɔ sye baar banswà bàsàwal mɔ̈ɔ̈,
wɛɛ mbuur mbuur kà un'lwaaŋ ande: sɛmà akà Klistɔ, ungö, baar abà amu Klistɔ, utaaŋ a ngyeel ande.
Apan, ntsüü waa isàyà, mpal usàfuur nde imwol akà Taa Nzam, ungö mudwa imfum kyanswà, ikɔ̈b kyanswà, ngwal yanswà.
Ntɔn nde akyer ayaal, tii mpal usàsà nde ayiiŋ ande banswà ungyɛl a in'kɔl ande.
Un'yiiŋ a ntsüü bàsàdwà wà ukwà.
Ntɔn, nde indiir byanswà kàsi ungyɛl a in'kɔl ande. Wɛɛ utɛɛnà nde naa: « Indiir byanswà byà ungyɛl a in'kɔl », iswaŋà naa mbuur kun'syeel bya ungyɛl a in'kɔl mwo watɛy.
Umpal naa indiir byanswà ban'sà ungyɛl a Klistɔ, apan Mwan ŋakwo asàkal ungyɛl a mbuur kun'syeel indiir byanswà ungyɛl, ntɔn Nzam ukäl ya yanswà amu baar banswà.
Yàlàkal naa kà abwɛy anki, baar bàfàwal ndüümà ntɔn akü, ininà bàlàleŋ? Isàkal yà ipepey naa akü bàwiyà anki, ntɔn nkye bàfàwal ba ndüümà ntɔn ba?
Wɛɛ bi ŋakwo, ntɔn nkye taaŋ lanswà ibà bi u mpay?
Wɛɛ mɛ in'fàkwà ilä byanswà, yà ndandaa sye, atɔŋ, naa bɛ làbà uyɔl amɛ amu Yɛsu Klistɔ, Mwol abi.
Ininà mɛ kàlàwal munwan a ntsür u Ifɛsɔ isàkal naa mɛ kàkäl unsà imbuur? Isàkal naa akü bàwiyà anki, wɛy bi idi anà inü, ntɔn nkàswo bi ikyer akwà.
Twon bàlakür: isam ibe ifàbwiy nkääl aŋàbwaŋ.
Làfuur an'kyän ubwaŋàbwaŋ, làwɛy mukyer man'be. Ntɔn bamwɛy Nzam bàyöb anki, mɛ ya an'tɛn ntɔn nswɛn abɛ.
Ndür a baar bàwiyà
Wɛɛ mbuur mwɛy ayàtɛn naa: « Akü bàyàwiyà aben? Ndür nà ba bàyàfurà ayà? »
Insil! Ngye, imbɛŋ afàkɔn ngye, kya mumɛn itwab afàtàkwà.
Undiir afàkɔn ngye, kà un'tɛ awà uyàmɛn anki, wɛɛ imbɛŋ a ipɔl, kyà blɛ itàkal kyà undiir asin.
Ungö, Nzam kun'pà ndür, asànaa ukwen nde anà akà imbɛŋ imbɛŋ a ndür akya ŋakwo.
Akà ndür mwɛy balàbal yatɛy anà yumwɛy: ye anà nsöön uboo a ndür a baar, yà ntsür, yà nɛn, yà nsö.
Ye anà ndür a du anà ndür a mɛɛn, un'nyäŋ a ya wà nsöön,
umwɛy un'nyäŋ a taaŋ, umwɛy wà nsöŋ, umwɛy wà mbwaar. Mbwaar mwɛy wà nsöön a mbwaar wumwɛy unsà un'nyäŋ.
Ya ye abwey sye ntɔn ngwiiyà a akü: bàfàkɔn ndür ifàpɔɔn, ifàwiyà ndür mpa ifàpɔɔn.
Bàfàkɔn ndür a nswɛn, ifàwiyà unsà làkoo, bàfàkɔn unsà gyɔ̈ɔ̈là, ifàwiyà aŋàyɔl a ngwal.
Bàfàkɔn ndür a ntsür, ifàwiyà ndür a dweelà. Isàkal naa ye anà ndür a ntsür, ye anà ndür a dweelà sye.
Kyakin, bàsön naa: « Adam, mbuur atàtwɛb, kàkäl ntsür a mbuur, Adam wà ntsüü wà mbuur a dweelà afàpà mɔ̈ɔ̈. »
Wɛɛ undiir wàtàtwɛb, wà ntsür a mbuur, ungö, mbuur a dweelà.
Mbuur atàtwɛb kàfü u mɛɛn, mbuur wàyweel kàfü du.
Baar a mɛɛn bà ifà imwɛy anà mbuur bàboom a tɔm, baar a du bà ifà imwɛy anà mbuur kàfü du.
Ifà imwɛy naa bi kàbwäär ifà a tɔm, bi isàbwaar sye ifà a mbuur a du.
Atɔŋ, ndaa in'tɛn mɛ ayi: in'twaŋ anà an'kil màkwe anki mubilà kà Imwol a Nzam, itàkal undiir afàpɔɔn ufàwal anki undiir mpa afàpɔɔn.
Wɛɛ mɛ inkwen mukàlakyään ngyee mwɛy. Bi banswà isàkwà anki, wɛɛ bi banswà ikyer asàsɔɔmà,
u mbalà mwɛy, kà imbürà imbürà u saay a mfuŋ. Ntɔn saay a mfuŋ a ntsüü làkyer asàbɛɛr, akü bàkyer asàwiyà anà ndür aba mpa isàpɔɔn, wɛɛ bi, bi ikyer asàsɔɔmà.
Kyakin, yà naa ndür ifàpɔɔn ibwäär ndür mpa ifàpɔɔn, ndür ifàkwà ibwäär ndür mpa ifàkwà.
Utaaŋ ndür ifàpɔɔn ayi isàbwaar ya ndür mpa ifàpɔɔn, anà ndür ifàkwà isàbwaar ya ndür mpa ifàkwà, abun isàkwo ndaa bàsön naa: « Iböŋ kyan'min ukwà.

content.text: Ukwà ngwal a ba man'be, ngwal a man'be, un'kɔɔn.
Wɛɛ bi ifuur an'tɔɔn akà Nzam, nde mbuur afàpà iböŋ u mbwo a Mwol abi Yɛsu Klistɔ.

content: Kyakin, atɔŋ amɛ bànkwen, làkäl ngwal, làkäl aŋàtsim, làpɛ mɔ̈ɔ̈ taaŋ lanswà unsà isal a Mwol, làyöb naa isal abɛ unsà Mwol kà kyà bunàbun anki.
